# sustain_repeating_maintenance (Resource)

Maintenance on the same days of every week, at the same time by its time zone's clocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploys on Tuesday and Thursday nights: their failures alert nobody.
resource "sustain_repeating_maintenance" "deploys" {
  title            = "Deploys"
  days             = ["tue", "thu"]
  start_time       = "02:00"
  duration_minutes = 30
  time_zone        = "Europe/London"
  message          = "Releasing the week's changes."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (List of String) The days it starts on, Monday first: mon to sun.
- `duration_minutes` (Number)
- `start_time` (String) When it starts on each, by its time zone's clocks: 02:00.
- `time_zone` (String) An IANA time zone, as Europe/London.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `client_ids` (List of String) The clients it covers, with the services each has as each time runs.
- `message` (String) What the status page says about each of its times.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) The monitors it covers, or null for every one.
- `service_ids` (List of String) The services it covers, with their monitors; none when it covers every monitor.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_repeating_maintenance.deploys <id>
```
